blocks.text: It is a source of power that makes the wheels go around. It is an internal-combustion engine because the gasoline (fuel) is burned inside it. This produces high pressure in the engine combustion chambers, forcing the pistons to move; the movement is carried by connecting rods to the engine crankshaft. The crankshaft is thus made to rotate; the rotary motion is carried through the power train to the wheels so that they rotate and the car moves. The engine requires a fuel system to supply it with a mixture of air and fuel. The fuel system which pumps liquid gasoline from a tank into the carburator, a mixing device that mixes the gasoline with air. The mixture is delivered to the engine where it is burned. The engine also needs a cooling system to take heat away from the engine by circulating a liquid coolant between the engine and the radiator.

The engine includes a lubricating system to supply all moving parts inside the engine with lubricating oil. The engine requires an ignition system which provides high-voltage-electric sparks that ignite the charges of air-fuel mixture in the engine combustion chambers.

items: *Joe:* Hello, Mrs. Lane. Your car’s ready.
*Mrs. Lane:* What was the problem, Joe?
*Joe:* We replaced the alternator and put in a new battery.
*Mrs. Lane:* Did you check the brakes?
*Joe:* Yes, I had to adjust the brakes and the clutch.
*Mrs. Lane:* And the oil?
*Joe:* Yes, we changed the oil and the oil filter. We also put in new points and plugs. I had to clean the carburator and flush the radiator.
*Mrs. Lane:* Did you grease it?
*Joe:* Yes, we greased all the points.
*Mrs. Lane:* Were the hoses OK?
*Joe:* Yes, no problem. I had to balance the wheels, they were out of alignment. I rotated the tires, I put the old ones on the back. You need new tires, and a new spare.
*Mrs. Lane:* How much do radial tires cost?
*Joe:* You can get good ones for about $ 50 each.
*Mrs. Lane:* I’ll tell Mr. Lane tonight. How much is the bill, Joe?
*Joe:* The repairs are $160; $ 60 for the spare parts and $100 for labor. And $ 60 for the service. That’ll be $ 220 and remember, your battery has a two-year warranty.
*Mrs. Lane:* Will you take a check?
*Joe:* It’s all right, make it out to Joe’s Auto Service.
*Mrs. Lane:* OK. Here you are. Thanks a lot.
